scope: Published-design validation under FR-K26-4d v1; no fitted effect

checks.source_panel_and_counts: pass: exact 4d, 34/30/25 and three explicit batch labels
checks.unit: nA magnitude shown on final Fig4d axis; source contract expects pA_magnitude
checks.published_replicates: three independent differentiations declared in Fig4d legend; Methods say three cultures
checks.allocation: reporting-summary pp2-3: intervention groups in parallel wells from the same differentiation; no randomization
checks.blinding: reporting-summary p3: spinal motor neuron electrophysiology blinded
checks.exclusions: reporting-summary p2 declares all data included; no per-record QC/exclusion ledger recovered
checks.nested_ids: no per-value cell, culture or coverslip identifier columns in 4d; exact mapping not supplied
checks.per_value_record_day: not supplied; Methods give DIV60-70 window
checks.explicit_batch_to_differentiation_key: not supplied; grouping is consistent with author-declared design but full nesting is not independently reconstructible
checks.author_R_script: available, REML log1p group plus batch intercept; needs explicit sheet/header adaptation

interpretation: The public source supports inspection and a possible assumption-conditional published-batch replay. It does not satisfy every strict v1 metadata requirement; do not invent IDs, exact dates or human approval. Any weaker replay needs an explicit prospective amendment before fitting.
needed_clarification: Whether Batch 1-3 each denote one independent differentiation and whether every numeric entry is one distinct neuron.
Whether shared cultures/coverslips or repeated recordings create additional nesting; provide an existing mapping if available.
Available per-record timing/QC or exclusions; do not require authors to adopt our schema.
